neutral.EN: Watch your mouth.
neutral.TL: Ingatan mo ang bibig mo.

neutral.EN: Check your tone.
neutral.TL: Ayusin mo ang tono mo.

neutral.EN: You do not want to talk to me like that.
neutral.TL: Huwag mo akong kakausapin nang ganyan.

neutral.EN: Mind how you speak to me.
neutral.TL: Mag-ingat ka sa pagsasalita mo sa akin.

neutral.EN: Lower your voice and watch your words.
neutral.TL: Hinaan mo ang boses mo at bantayan ang dila mo.

neutral.EN: You are crossing a line with that mouth.
neutral.TL: Sumusobra ka na sa mga sinasabi mo.

neutral.EN: Bite your tongue before I lose patience.
neutral.TL: Kagatin mo ang dila mo bago maubos ang pasensya ko.

neutral.EN: Watch it.
neutral.TL: Mag-ingat ka.

neutral.EN: That mouth of yours is going to get you hurt.
neutral.TL: Ipapahamak ka ng bibig mong 'yan.

neutral.EN: Careful what comes out of your mouth next.
neutral.TL: Bantayan mo ang susunod na lalabas sa bibig mo.

neutral.EN: Try that again and see what happens.
neutral.TL: Ulitin mo 'yan at tingnan natin ang mangyayari.

neutral.EN: Say that one more time. I dare you.
neutral.TL: Subukan mong sabihin 'yan ulit. Hinahamon kita.

neutral.EN: Push me again and find out.
neutral.TL: Itulak mo pa ako at nang malaman mo.

neutral.EN: Do not test my patience.
neutral.TL: Huwag mong subukan ang pasensya ko.

neutral.EN: Keep pushing. See where it lands you.
neutral.TL: Sige, magpumilit ka pa. Tingnan natin kung saan ka pupulutin.

neutral.EN: One more step out of line and we have a problem.
neutral.TL: Isa pang maling kilos mo at magkakaproblema tayo.

neutral.EN: You really want to go down this road?
neutral.TL: Gusto mo ba talagang daanan ang landas na 'to?

neutral.EN: Try it. See how fast this goes south.
neutral.TL: Sige, subukan mo. Tingnan natin kung gaano kabilis magkakagulo.

neutral.EN: You are gambling with your safety right now.
neutral.TL: Isinusugal mo ang kaligtasan mo ngayon.

neutral.EN: Last warning. Back off.
neutral.TL: Huling babala. Lumayo ka.

neutral.EN: You need to back off right now.
neutral.TL: Kailangan mong lumayo ngayon din.

neutral.EN: Step back.
neutral.TL: Umatras ka.

neutral.EN: Give me space before things get ugly.
neutral.TL: Bigyan mo ako ng puwang bago magkagulo rito.

neutral.EN: Back away from me.
neutral.TL: Lumayo ka sa akin.

neutral.EN: I said back off.
neutral.TL: Sabi ko umatras ka.

neutral.EN: Keep your distance.
neutral.TL: Panatilihin mo ang distansya mo.

neutral.EN: Get out of my face.
neutral.TL: Umalis ka sa harap ko.

neutral.EN: You have about two seconds to back up.
neutral.TL: May dalawang segundo ka para umatras.

neutral.EN: Take a step back while you still can.
neutral.TL: Umatras ka habang kaya mo pa.

neutral.EN: Back off. I will not say it again.
neutral.TL: Umatras ka. Hindi ko na uulitin ito.
